fields.description: Farm Gardens 2 brings four- and five-bedroom villas to The Valley, with communal growing spaces woven into a gated residential neighbourhood. Emaar presents two architectural styles, Horizon and Oren, alongside gardens, recreation areas and a community centre. The setting is intended for families seeking more outdoor space.

overview: The neighbourhood plan gives shared food-growing spaces a practical role: a greenhouse and vegetable gardens sit alongside leisure facilities. Emaar also proposes an orchard, shaded gathering spaces and a community centre. Wider Valley facilities, including its Town Centre and Golden Beach, belong to the master community rather than each villa’s private plot.
research.locationNote: Farm Gardens 2 is part of The Valley on Dubai–Al Ain Road (E66). Access is road-based; check the actual commute and entrance arrangements for a selected plot rather than relying on promotional journey times.
research.priceNote: Emaar displays AED 7.26m. The launch sheet lists four-bedroom Horizon/Oren from AED 7.26m/7.30m and five-bedroom Horizon/Oren from AED 9.20m/9.24m. Property Finder shows higher references. These are differently dated starting figures, not confirmed available-unit quotations.
research.paymentNote: The February 2024 launch schedule allocates 10% to booking, 80% across eight later stages and 10% to completion. Construction milestones are conditions in that historical schedule, not statements of current progress. Request the terms applicable to the selected home.
research.handoverNote: The Emaar-branded payment sheet estimates March 2028. Property Finder also reports March 2028 and Bayut states Q1 2028. The sale contract and current developer confirmation govern delivery.

facts.label: Launch collection
facts.value: 256 villas; this historical development count does not indicate homes currently for sale.

facts.label: Area definitions
facts.value: Published totals include suite, garage and applicable balconies, entrance or terrace areas. Plot area is land size and must be read separately.

facts.label: Villa arrangement
facts.value: Plans show ground, first and roof levels, a lift, guest bedroom, maid’s and driver’s accommodation, two kitchens and a roof lounge/terrace. Confirm the specification for the selected variant.

facts.label: Interior palette
facts.value: The material board shows pale finishes, wood-toned joinery, veined counters, fluted glass and metal accents. It does not establish final brands or the contractual material specification.

facts.label: Landscape design intent
facts.value: The brochure describes drought-tolerant planting, shading and automated treated-water irrigation. These proposals are not a building certification or a quantified utility-saving guarantee.

unresolved: The brochure’s 431–564 sq m range and Bayut’s corresponding approximate range do not reconcile with the detailed plan totals. The table therefore uses the individually labelled floor plans; request the signed unit-area schedule.
A pool is depicted in illustrative plans, but the reviewed material does not clearly establish the supplied pool and landscaping scope. Confirm inclusions before purchase.
Floor plans, payment terms and launch fact/material sheets are Emaar-branded documents hosted by Jiwak, not developer-hosted downloads. Obtain the latest issue directly from Emaar.
Available homes, exact plot boundaries, service charges, final finishes and contractual completion require current written confirmation. Existing site photographs remain illustrative.
